name: Hotel La Perla
insider_take: Nestled in the heart of the Dolomites UNESCO World Heritage site, this alpine jewel sits at 1,568 meters elevation where Italian hospitality meets spectacular mountain drama.
whats_special: Hotel La Perla is perfectly positioned on the legendary Sella Ronda ski circuit, offering direct access to 500km of pristine slopes. The hotel's location in Corvara provides a front-row seat to the famous "Enrosadira" phenomenon, where the Dolomite peaks glow pink and orange at sunset—a natural light show that occurs nowhere else on Earth.
pro_tip: Book a south-facing room to witness the breathtaking Enrosadira from your window, and time your visit during December or January when the snow coverage is most spectacular for both skiing and photography.
dont_miss: The nearby Passo Campolongo offers one of the most scenic drives in the Alps, while the traditional Ladin culture of Alta Badia provides unique culinary experiences—this region boasts the highest concentration of Michelin-starred mountain restaurants in the world, blending Italian, Austrian, and ancient Ladin influences.
pros: Prime location in the heart of the Dolomites with direct ski access
Luxurious alpine wellness spa with mountain views
Exceptional Michelin-quality dining featuring local South Tyrolean cuisine
Elegant blend of traditional Ladin culture and modern luxury amenities
cons: Remote mountain location requires travel planning
Seasonal accessibility dependent on weather conditions
